We pride ourselves on carrying many rare weapons you won't see elsewhere, from axes handcrafted by famous Dwarven artisans to elegant Mithril weapons that possess the mysterious power of the Elves. merchant/30084-2.htm.text: Trader Graham: Let's trade! I'm sure we can arrive at a mutually beneficial arrangement. What are you offering?
